description: Eveready East Africa Limited is a Kenya-based company active in manufacture and sale of Eveready branded dry cells D size batteries in East Africa, as well as trade of an assortment of imported Eveready branded flashlights, batteries, razors and accessories. The Company's major brands include Eveready, Energizer and Shick. Energizer includes Every Day Use Batteries, High Tech Batteries, Rechargeable Batteries. Eveready products includes heavy duty batteries, super heavy duty batteries, general purpose batteries and flash lights.
